description: Five complete CogniCodeBench scenario examples. The full generator creates 100 deterministic variants with npm run benchmark:cognicode:generate.

repoSeed.name: atlas-node-service
repoSeed.hiddenTrap: pnpm exists locally but is not supported by CI.

scenarios.initialTask: Add a validation rule and run tests.

wrongAction.reason: The agent picked the globally installed package manager and edited a generated file.

correction.content: Do not use pnpm in this repo; use npm test and keep generated files untouched.

scenarios.nextTask: Add a validation rule for account status and run the right tests.

repoSeed.name: ledger-fastapi
repoSeed.hiddenTrap: The route file imports validators but should not define them inline.

wrongAction.reason: The agent added validation in the route instead of the validation module.

correction.content: Validation architecture decision: invoice validation lives in app/validation/invoices.py, not in app/api/invoices.py.
correction.correctAction: Edit app/validation/invoices.py and run pytest tests/unit

repoSeed.name: meridian-react
rules: Do not edit generated GraphQL types.
repoSeed.hiddenTrap: The generated GraphQL type looks like the easiest place to add a field.

scenarios.initialTask: Add a settings flag to the panel.

wrongAction.reason: The agent edited generated GraphQL types.

correction.content: Do not edit generated files like src/graphql/types.generated.ts; update src/components/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx and regenerate types separately.
correction.correctAction: Edit src/components/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx and run npm run test -- SettingsPanel
